name: sim_mera_clifford_weyl_bridge_claims_canonical

bridge_claims.B2: I_c co-varies with Q_MCW across 5 random seeds
bridge_claims.B4: z3 UNSAT on negative eigenvalues of rho_MCW
bridge_claims.B5: z3 UNSAT on I_c > log(chi) (bond dimension bound)

clifford.reason: Cl(3) rotor encoded as explicit matrix; package not required

geomstats.reason: geometry handled with analytic expressions; Riemannian manifold library is outside this probe's scope

divergence_log: canonical: pytorch + z3 + sympy all load-bearing
rho_MCW = P_L @ R(theta) @ rho @ R(theta).T @ P_L (projection of rotated state)
I_c proxy uses off-diagonal block norm after QR coarse-graining
BC3 gradient uses 1/(layer+1) proxy for MERA depth scaling
BC4 z3 encodes PSD-projection argument; lam >= 0 from first principles
BC5 z3 encodes bond dimension bound S_B <= log(chi)

Pearson correlation requirement: positive co-variation, not strict monotonicity
